## Design

### 2026-10-05 — October 5th: Requiem XT Gaming Controller

**2.5h**

October 5th: Requiem XT Gaming Controller

So I Opened KiCad Created A New Project , as i have spent decent amount of time understanding how to add buttons and connect wires.

For starting i added Raspberry Pi Pico in Schematic editor and started adding all required buttons,
i need to add 14 Buttons instead of standard 12 like every controller because i am using buttons instead of analog triggers.

14 Buttons I added In This Session:
1) BUTTON_A        5) DPAD_UP           9) START
2) BUTTON_B        6) DPAD_DOWN    10) SELECT
3) BUTTON_X        7) DPAD_LEFT
4) BUTTON_Y        8) DPAD_RIGHT

11) BUTTON_RT  (Can't call them triggers any more)
12) BUTTON_RB
13) BUTTON_LT
14) BUTTON_LB

![Schematic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/46228660f232f13506d572d61a75310720048b2f3d30c7c091c16468618d2865.png)

After adding buttons i started adding joystick, after finding out how to add that,
i added GND and +3V3 on Conn_01x04 Connector then connected the bottom 2 pins to GPIO26 / ADC0 and GPIO27 / ADC1 pins.

The hardest part was making sure wires don’t overlap so it took quite a bit of time understanding how to place everything without making a mess.

After i ran electrical rule checker all my excitement was gone 22 errors!
what a great start 🤡.

![Electrical Rule Check 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/634c0b7c00afcdc5838fbd525014003d1e61b507d3d2ec930d2f4d50bd422a3a.png)

But who would have thought just adding few x on unused pins will lower errors to 13.

![Electrical Rule Check 2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/e209f314df06f4f4c133df502c89b5f69514971b4708bc577a39e3dd5a47325e.png)

Main Thing As complete beginner was understanding how the whole KiCad works if i haven’t spend a full day learning before half life started,
this it would have taken whole day.

Time Spent This Session: 2.5 Hour

### 2026-10-06 — October 6: ADC Pin Trouble

**5h**

October 6: ADC Pin Trouble

I Started today's session with solving remaining Electrical rule errors and adding the last joystick but i just found out joystick requires 2 ADC pins to connect but Raspberry Pi Pico only exposes 3 of those pins.
I did bit of researching and the only options i found are either i have to use analog multiplexer IC or external I2C/SPI ADC chip which i don’t want because that will make things a lot complicated and budget might also break.

![Schematic1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/01e1421cf554a82b926b965f09ff2130930f8613627757789cc3457e34c43d78.png)

So I Started to look for a different daughterboard And found Waveshare RP2040 Zero which is 100% Compatible and exposes all 4 ADC Pins.
I found the required files to add in KiCad, Created new project and imported the New Board.

Adding Buttons again was quite easy only problem was wires as this board was little smaller than PI Pico

![Schematic2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/e13b201141ffbc435f9bec5f9a72af28d9732d502bbe506182301a348237b862.png)

I added all buttons only 2 joysticks left, i ran Electrical Rule Checker for fun and as expected 13 errors WTH!

![ERC1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/ca90056e4175297940a88e8cf3d5aa38c02506f4dd663ffd37484c6d508986bb.png)

I added joysticks, after adding both joysticks and some cross mark on unused pins errors dropped to 8 but i didn’t felt happy because i have no idea what else is left as i already added all buttons and 2 joysticks.

![Schematic3](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/d27390914a1c5c9663357abbd929a074078ce5e5ad653c98a925256dcb3e7837.png)

![ERC2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/33710488e65344fbe109a8faff32a63479463083906efa056143370da5d6b18c.png)

After doing a strategic discussion with ChatGPT i found out i need to add GND and 3v3 on board so i followed instructions and slowly started solving errors and it worked most errors got solved, only a warning about footprint left so i started solving the footprint issue and it all happened because i added footprint folder in symbol library.

![ERC3](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/da6e29e5f4d8c1a963986c7ccd753e46fe711ce33d7e936489882b29b2b3e012.png)

I  assigned all footprints fun part was buttons they all only needed BUTTON_SWITCH_THT:SW_PUSH-6mm as footprint it was done fairly quickly

![FOOTPRINT](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/5b03add1aef2872d4de36cc62e1ae116a9414b567330ec713b2a2c15b7b0283f.png)

What I learnt in this session: Read KiCad Import instructions carefully a small word change can waste 20 mins finding out why footprint is not working.

Time Spent This Session: 5 Hours
